name: mindbridge
description: A relaxed little AI brain that rebuilds context from what it knows about you.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix MindBridge-UI install && dotnet build MindBridge-API
scripts.dev: concurrently -c "cyan,magenta" -n "UI,API" "npm --prefix MindBridge-UI run dev" "dotnet run --project MindBridge-API"
